List is a method that takes a "MalfeasanceRequest" body and returns an "MalfeasanceList".
This method is used to retrieve a list of malfeasance proofs based on the provided request parameters.

params.name: smesherId
params.description: list of smesher ids to fetch (can be empty for all)

params.name: offset
params.description: adjusts the starting point for data

params.name: limit
params.description: specifies max number of items to fetch
